title: Autopoietic systems may not be Turing-computable

statements.text: If autopoietic systems are a subset of Rosen’s metabolism-repair systems, which are not Turing-computable, then a living being is not a machine in that abstract sense. This would challenge the original placement of autopoiesis among cybernetic mechanisms and its capture by cellular automata.

sources.quote: It would seem to follow that autopoietic systems are not Turing-computable
